name: Feet in Straps — Lowers & Circles
summary: Feet in the long loops with straight legs: lower them towards the springs and lift, then circle them. Hamstrings, inner thighs and a steady pelvis.
steps: Lie on the back with the long loops over the feet, tailbone heavy.
Legs straight up, just in front of the hips.
Lowers: breathe out to press the legs down towards the springs; breathe in to lift them over the hips.
Circles: breathe out to open, lower and join the legs; breathe in to squeeze them back up.

layers.title: Prop
layers.text: Ball or ring between the ankles.

modifications: Lighter spring if the pelvis rocks.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.
Small circles; don't cross the midline or go past 90° of hip bend.

cues:
Tailbone stays down.
The back doesn't arch as the legs lower.
Shoulders and neck relaxed.
Feel the inner thighs as the legs meet.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
